state: Hello, I've been a customer for about six years and I've honestly never had to write one of these before, so bear with me. I ordered the patio set (table + 4 chairs) back at the start of the month for my daughter's graduation party. The website said it would arrive in 5-7 days, it took almost three weeks, which meant we ended up renting chairs for the party anyway. Fine, things happen. When it finally showed up, one of the chair legs was bent pretty badly, it looks like something heavy was dropped on the box, and the table glass has a scratch across the middle. I've attached pics of both. I could probably live with the scratch. The bent leg means that chair wobbles and I wouldn't let anyone sit on it. On top of all that I just looked at my card statement and I was charged twice for this order, two identical charges on the same day for the full amount. That's the part that really needs fixing ASAP, because that's a lot of money sitting on my card. I called on Tuesday and was told someone would email me within 48 hours and nobody did. I really don't want to have to spend another hour on hold. I'm honestly thinking twice about ordering from you again, which is a shame because I've always liked your stuff. Please let me know what the next steps are. Thanks, Dana
